# Shape N Shades – Luxury Architecture & Interior Design Studio

Shape N Shades is a premier full-service architecture, interior design, and construction consulting firm based in Dadar East, Mumbai, Maharashtra. Founded on 9th September 2019 by Principal Architect Ar. Sohan Suthar.

## Studio Details
- **Founder & Principal Architect**: Ar. Sohan Suthar
- **Founded**: September 9, 2019
- **Address**: Shed No 1, Ground Floor, Balaji Building No 2 (Umia Estate), M M G S Marg, Dadar East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400014, India
- **Phone**: +91 80972 41237
- **Email**: design.shapenshades@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://shapenshades.com/

## Core Design Services
- **Architecture**: Custom structural blueprints, space planning, elevations, villa design, and architectural supervision.
- **Interior Design**: Turnkey luxury residential interior design, high-end apartment transformations, modular kitchens, and custom furniture.
- **Commercial Workspaces**: Corporate offices, retail outlets, showrooms, and hospitality interior design tailored to brand identity.
- **Landscape & Vastu Planning**: Vastu-compliant green layouts, open terraces, and outdoor living environments.
- **Construction Administration**: On-site supervision, vendor coordination, quality audits, and end-to-end execution.

## Geographic Coverage
Active project footprint across Mumbai Metropolitan Region (Dadar East, Bandra, Matunga, Ghatkopar, Kandivali, Bhayandar East, Thane) as well as Nashik, Delhi, Ratnagiri, and Kolhapur.
